verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS changelog and feedback platform like Beamer, but the evidence pack never documents a data export feature, export formats, or account portability. The mentions of an API, webhooks and a HubSpot sync are developer building blocks or adjacent integrations, not a first-party export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
